consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 10/12/1983 show at Madison Square Garden was a standout performance, particularly praising the energy and musicianship throughout the night. The first set is frequently highlighted as exceptional, with notable moments in songs like 'Cold Rain & Snow' and 'Help on the Way~Slipknot!~Franklin's Tower'.
